COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
CRJA No. 27 of 2022
Hon’ble S.K. Mishra, ACJ.
Hon’ble R.C. Khulbe, J.
Shri J.S. Virk, learned Deputy Advocate 
General and Shri Rakesh Kumar Joshi, 
learned Brief Holder for the State are present. 
This is a jail appeal. 
We have perused the record. The office 
has reported that there is no delay in filing of 
this appeal. Hence, the appeal is admitted. 
Smt. Lovely Grover, Advocate, is 
appointed as Amicus Curiae to argue the case 
on behalf of the appellant. 
Call for the scanned copies (both hard 
and soft copy) of the trial court record. After 
receiving the trial court record, the Registry 
shall prepare the paper book and supply the 
same to learned Amicus Curiae and learned 
Deputy Advocate General, as per Rules. 
Matter be listed for final hearing, as and 
when directed.
(R.C. Khulbe, J.) (S.K. Mishra, ACJ.)
12.05.2022
PV
